title: LiveVVT: High-Fidelity Video Virtual Try-On in Real Time
abstract: arXiv:2608.26714v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion-based Video Virtual Try-On (VVT) achieves high visual fidelity through bidirectional spatio-temporal modeling, but complete-clip dependence incurs prohibitive latency and computational overhead in practical continuous deployment. Naively enforcing causality disrupts pretrained bidirectional priors and substantially degrades synthesis quality. We introduce LiveVVT, a rolling streaming diffusion framework that preserves bounded bidirectional modeling within causal recurrent generation. Within a fixed-size window, LiveVVT jointly denoises multiple video chunks under bounded look-ahead, preserving local bidirectional interactions while emitting one clean chunk per iteration. translated_title: LiveVVT：实时高保真视频虚拟试穿
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26714v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于扩散的视频虚拟试穿（VVT）通过双向时空建模实现了高视觉保真度，但在实际连续部署中，完整片段依赖会导致极高的延迟和计算开销。简单强制因果性会破坏预训练的双向先验，并显著降低合成质量。我们引入了LiveVVT，一种滚动流式扩散框架，在因果循环生成中保留有界双向建模。在固定大小窗口内，LiveVVT在有限前瞻下联合去噪多个视频块，保持局部双向交互，同时每次迭代生成一个干净块。在窗口之外，两种互补记忆维持长期一致性：有界时间记忆传播近期动态和遮挡上下文，而持久全局外观记忆（从目标服装和正面试穿一次性构建）确保服装细节的一致性。
tldr: LiveVVT提出了一种滚动流式扩散框架，在因果循环生成中保留有界双向建模，通过有界时间记忆和全局外观记忆实现实时高保真视频虚拟试穿，克服了传统方法的高延迟和计算开销问题。
en_tdlr: LiveVVT proposes a rolling streaming diffusion framework that preserves bounded bidirectional modeling within causal recurrent generation, using bounded temporal and global appearance memories to achieve real-time high-fidelity video virtual try-on, overcoming the latency and computational overhead of traditional methods.
